text: Between steps 2000 and 4000, val_mse_ratio falls 5-7x while linear accel_step R2 gains only about 0.02. Is that late MSE gain concentrated on pericentre snapshots (r/a < 0.4)? Per-checkpoint val MSE and accel_step probe residual, binned by r/a, would show whether late training refines exactly the high-acceleration region that the linear probe fails to read.
